No exact street address for the ICE02 facility was confirmed via search, so this entry uses Reykjanesbaer town-center coordinates rather than a guessed street address.
locations.location_mapping[23].location_source_not: This location_id was used by a job (Facilities Engineer) but had no location_mapping entry. Web search confirms Crusoe operates 'Crusoe Spark' modular AI data centers on Redwood Materials' campus in Sparks, Nevada, expanded from 4 to 24 modular units and powered by second-life EV batteries (Bloomberg, Latitude Media, HPCWire, all 2025-2026 coverage). No exact street address for the Redwood Materials campus was confirmed via search, so this entry uses Sparks, NV city-center coordinates rather than a guessed street address.
locations.location_mapping[24].location_source_not: This location_id was used by 4 construction-management job postings but had no location_mapping entry. Web search confirms Crusoe has active job listings 'near Abilene in Haskell County' (ZipRecruiter/ClimateTechList aggregations), consistent with Crusoe's broader West Texas data-center buildout in the same energy corridor as its confirmed Abilene and Childress campuses. Google separately has its own unrelated Haskell County data-center project; this entry is specific to Crusoe's own postings. No exact street address was confirmed via search, so this entry uses the town of Haskell, TX city-center coordinates rather than a guessed street address.
locations.location_mapping[25].location_source_not: This location_id was used by 3 manufacturing job postings (Assembly Technician, Inventory Control Coordinator, Production Manager) but had no location_mapping entry. Web search confirms Crusoe Industries (formed 2022 via acquisition of modular data center manufacturer Easter-Owens) operates a manufacturing/R&D facility in Ponchatoula, Louisiana that produces Crusoe Spark modular units, metal structures, electrical enclosures, and power distribution equipment. No exact street address was confirmed via search, so this entry uses Ponchatoula, LA city-center coordinates rather than a guessed street address.
